title: King Hussein Cancer Center — Our Doctors directory + facility pages
notes: 158 practitioners = every doctor on the EN and AR directory listing (identical slug sets), each profile fetched in EN and AR. specialty = the directory's own 'Search By Speciality' grouping (POST filter, one group per doctor); free-text position kept in extra.position_en/ar. grade set only where the position text contains 'Consultant'/'Specialist'. clinic_phones is the number printed on the profile (KHCC switchboard/extension); 4 profiles printing a Jordanian mobile (07x) were dropped as possibly personal. qualifications = EN 'Education and Training' + 'Board Certifications'; AR versions in extra.qualifications_ar. Publications/awards not captured. Facility: no bed total published on fetched pages (only ER bed counts); site states no local insurer agreements, so insurance_accepted is empty. robots.txt disallows only query-string variants and /node/; none used.
